method: All28 matched base-machine NPZ archives per family; equal-machine macro means; actual covered timeline only; ordinary AP/ROC are threshold-free descriptive scores; oracle threshold maximizes timestep F1 not event hit. Event hit = any positive prediction during one contiguous annotated event, without point adjustment; high event hit alone can be attained by excessive false alarms. Timeline comparison uses NPZ batch256, not decision-trace JSON batch1.
